title: Song of Trust and Deliverance

questions.question: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: "We have a strong city; he sets up salvation as walls and what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 26:1 (ESV): "he sets up salvation as walls and bulwarks."

questions.question: Open the gates, that the righteous nation that keeps what may enter in?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 26:2 (ESV): "that keeps faith may enter in."

questions.question: You keep him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on you, because he trusts in whom?
Trust in the LORD forever, for the LORD GOD is an everlasting what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 26:4 (ESV): "for the LORD GOD is an everlasting rock."

questions.question: The path of the righteous is what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 26:7 (ESV): "The path of the righteous is level;"

questions.question: O LORD, your hand is lifted up, but they do not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 26:11 (ESV): "your hand is lifted up, but they do not see it."

questions.question: O LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have indeed done for us all our what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 26:12 (ESV): "for you have indeed done for us all our works."

questions.question: O LORD our God, other lords besides you have ruled over us, but your name alone we do what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 26:13 (ESV): "but your name alone we bring to remembrance."

questions.question: Like a pregnant woman who writhes and cries out in her pangs when she is near to giving birth, so were we because of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 26:17 (ESV): "so were we because of you, O LORD."

questions.question: Your dead shall live; their bodies shall rise. You who dwell in the dust, awake and sing for what?
Come, my people, enter your chambers, and shut your doors behind you; hide yourselves for a little while until the fury has what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 26:20 (ESV): "until the fury has passed by."

questions.question: For behold, the LORD is coming out from his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 26:21 (ESV): "to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity,"

questions.question: And the earth will disclose the blood shed on it, and will no more cover its what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 26:21 (ESV): "and will no more cover its slain."

questions.question: We were pregnant, we writhed, but we have given birth to what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 26:18 (ESV): "but we have given birth to wind."

questions.question: For when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 26:9 (ESV): "the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness."

key_verse_text: You keep him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on you, because he trusts in you. Trust in the LORD forever, for the LORD GOD is an everlasting rock.
